components.name: Chart/Confidence meter
components.description: How sure the model is about an AI answer, forecast or generated chart. 5 segments: High 5 (status/success), Medium 3 (status/warning), Low 1 (status/danger); remainder dataviz/track. Always shows the level as text + a one-line reason — colour never carries meaning alone. React: <ConfidenceMeter level="high|medium|low" value={0.92} reason />

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Always show the level as text and a reason — colour never carries meaning alone.
Thresholds: High ≥ 80%, Medium 50–79%, Low < 50% (configurable per product).
Low confidence should lead to an action: check data, ask a person.
